request.description: Records an update for a lender that works offline: every action of the lender portal plus `answer_query` and `withdraw`. Sanction, disbursal and rejection need a `note` saying how the lender shared the decision, and sanction and disbursal need an `evidenceDocumentId`. Optional `expectedVersion` guards against two people acting at once. Staff context (ops leads and reviewers act; compliance, support and credit read).

response.name: 200 OK
